timing_directives.when_to_wait: If price opens or rises above ৳18.7, DO NOT HOP IN. Wait 2–5 trading sessions for dip back to ৳17.8.
timing_directives.capital_pacing_rule: Deploy maximum 25%–30% of target budget on Day 1. Reserve remaining 70% for systematic pullbacks over the next 2–4 weeks.

multi_interval_wave.phase_guidance: Near local cyclical trough base. Maximum reward/risk entry point.

causal_attributions.root_cause_why: Floor prices imposed on all stocks to stop free-fall. Artificially froze liquidity, trapped institutional capital, volume dried up to historic lows.

causal_attributions.event_name: Phased Floor Price Removal & Price Discovery
causal_attributions.root_cause_why: BSEC lifted floor prices in waves. Triggered sharp 1,000+ point DSEX correction as artificial valuations collapsed to fair market levels.

causal_attributions.event_name: SMART Interest Rate & Lending Cap Removal
causal_attributions.root_cause_why: Bangladesh Bank replaced fixed 9% lending cap with SMART rate, later moving to pure market-based repo tightening (repo hiked to 8.5%-10.0%). Corporate borrowing cost surged from 9% to 14-16%.
Mass protests, nationwide curfews, internet blackouts, supply chain shutdowns leading to resignation of government on Aug 5.
Interim government established under Dr. Yunus. BSEC leadership replaced, investigation task force formed against financial market manipulators and money laundering.

causal_attributions.event_name: Banking NPL Revelations & Aggressive Monetary Tightening
causal_attributions.root_cause_why: True extent of banking non-performing loans exposed by Bangladesh Bank. Liquidity squeeze in weak banks, high 12-14% treasury bill yields drew liquidity away from stock market.
FX reserves stabilized with IMF/World Bank assistance. Remittance surge. Selective institutional accumulation into debt-free cash cows with high dividend yields (Square, GP, Olympic, Padma Oil).
